title: Custom IoT Development | Devices, Firmware & Operational Software | Hitelecom
metaDescription: Explore custom IoT hardware, embedded firmware, digital-twin views and GIS dashboards, with application-led project scopes and RF coupling or temperature-pressure product selection.

categoryDescriptions.256: Bring device engineering and operational software into one project brief. Explore application-specific requirements, defined outputs and acceptance checks before choosing a development path or product configuration.
categoryDescriptions.278: Develop asset-context views, geographic workflows or embedded device behaviour around the data and interfaces your operation uses. Define the source information, user actions, delivery scope and acceptance checks for the selected service.
categoryDescriptions.279: Specify sensing interfaces, electronics, power, enclosures and production handover for a custom device, or review an existing RF coupling or temperature-pressure instrument against its intended installation.

catalogIntro: Use digital twins for asset context, GIS dashboards for geographic workflows, embedded software for device behaviour and hardware development for physical interfaces. Existing RF and temperature-pressure products follow their own selection requirements.
sharedConfigNote: Each development service defines inputs, proposed outputs and acceptance checks for the project. Hardware products have separate technical references and selection conditions. Source code, design files, third-party licences and support are agreed in the project scope.
